mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months indicates labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline amid weakening consumer spending.
failure_condition: Average 5-day SPX returns in UNRATE rise > 0.5pp periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for UNRATE change signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment signal a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE change) yields Rank IC below -0.03 in any 3-year window, or average 60-day returns in simultaneous rate hikes/unemployment rises are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining housing starts signal weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as housing-related sectors face reduced activity.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns in late-cycle expansion with declining HOUST are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for HOUST in this regime falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and weaker economic activity.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 as a 5-day SPX predictor falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window, or average 5-day returns in declining GDPC1 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A moderate inflation acceleration exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals strengthening economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as investors price in higher corporate profits from robust consumer demand.
failure_condition: Average 60-day SPX returns in CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3pp periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as manufacturing and consumer sectors drive earnings growth.
failure_condition: Interaction term (PAYEMS growth * INDPRO growth) yields Rank IC below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average 20-day returns in simultaneous growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes, declining industrial production signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output and sectoral earnings declines.
failure_condition: Average 5-day SPX returns in supply-constrained periods with declining INDPRO are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime falls below 0.03.
